relative_branch_status: A preexisting oriented/donor context can identify the branch relation relative to that context even though the 0/1 origin convention remains noncanonical.
structural_interpretation: The two maps are the two torsor identifications. They differ by the unique nontrivial automorphism of B (equivalently of H). Bare torsor data contain no distinguished origin or invariant that selects one identification.
theorem: These are exactly the two equivariant maps H->B. Choosing F(h0) for one h0 determines the other value by equivariance.
